{{Top|leg}}
'''Microfilament injectors''' were thin needles that could be used to dispense pain and [[Truth serum/Legends|truth drugs]]. They were installed on [[Agonizer-6 nerve disruptor]]s.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
